title: The Circle search field shows a keyboard focus ring

verify.note: Fails before the fix: .fqc-search input sets outline:0 and the wrapper has no :focus-within rule.

detail: Same class as the 2026-10-22 audit finding 1. The input inside .fqc-search removes its outline and nothing replaced it, so keyboard users get no indicator. The wrapper now carries a 2px outline in the focus-ring token on :focus-within.
